primary_task: Analyze keyword usage and density in provided content and return a keyword strategy package with LSI keywords, entities and over-optimization warnings.

requirements.name: web_search
requirements.basis: "web_search": "search the public web and read result snippets"

notes: The core approach works on "provided content" ("Extract current keyword usage from provided content", "Generate LSI keywords based on topic"), done by the agent itself. Competitor entity analysis appears only in the Entity Analysis Framework, not in the Approach steps, so it is treated as optional; reading competitor pages in full via web_fetch would be refused for hosts outside the allow-list ("hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused"), but snippets via web_search are available. WordPress plugin integration is advice text, not an action.
